question: Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is associated with which of the following dance style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is a renowned figure associated with the Kuchipudi dance style.
 
• He comes from a long line of traditional Kuchipudi gurus and has been instrumental in preserving and promoting this classical dance form.
 
• **Kuchipudi is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh**, known for its graceful movements, dramatic expressions, and unique style of storytelling through dance.
 
• Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry has contributed to the evolution of Kuchipudi by blending traditional and contemporary elements.
 
• His family has been deeply rooted in the development of Kuchipudi as a prominent classical dance form in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/989639b1181533b1a52253c99330e69cd1ab2906344963d4ebcc7c80bc3ddc01.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya:**

 
 
• Sattriya is a classical dance form from** Assam.**
 
• It was traditionally performed by monks in monasteries (Sattras) as part of their devotion to Lord Vishnu.
 
• It is not related to Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry.
 
 
 
• **Bharatnatyam:**
 
 
• Bharatnatyam is a classical dance form from **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It emphasizes fixed upper torso, intricate footwork, and expressive hand gestures.
 
• While it is one of the most famous dance forms in India, it is not linked to Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry.
 
 
 
• **Kathak:**
 
 
• Kathak is a classical dance style from **North India**, associated with storytelling through rhythmic foot movements and spins.
 
• It originated from the traveling bards of ancient northern India.
 
• Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is not associated with this dance form.
